items.exampleEn: The concert tickets sold out in ten minutes.
items.exampleZh: 演唱會的票十分鐘就賣完了。

items.exampleEn: We set out early to avoid the traffic.
items.exampleZh: 我們很早就出發，避開車潮。

items.exampleEn: There's no need to show off. We know you're good at math.
items.exampleZh: 不用炫耀了，我們知道你數學很好。

items.exampleEn: My brother often sleeps in and misses breakfast.
items.exampleZh: 我的兄弟常常睡懶覺，錯過早餐。

items.exampleEn: I need to sort out my clothes before I move.
items.exampleZh: 搬家前我得整理一下我的衣服。

items.exampleEn: The train sped up after it left the station.
On this map, the blue lines stand for rivers.
items.exampleZh: 在這張地圖上，藍線代表河流。

items.sentenceEn: Can you speed things up a little? We're going to be late.
items.sentenceZh: 你可以開快一點嗎？我們快遲到了。

items.audioEn: All the shirts in my size had sold out, so I left with nothing.
items.audioZh: 我這個尺寸的襯衫全都賣完了，所以我什麼也沒買就走了。
items.questionZh: 說話的人為什麼什麼都沒買？
options: None were left in that size

items.sentenceEn: She set out to write a book about her hometown.
items.sentenceZh: 她著手寫一本關於她家鄉的書。

items.sentenceEn: Let's sort this problem out before the weekend.
items.sentenceZh: 我們在週末前把這個問題解決吧。

items.stemEn: It was a holiday, so I turned off my alarm and ____ until ten.
items.stemZh: 那天是假日，所以我關掉鬧鐘，睡懶覺睡到十點。

items.stemEn: What does this red light ____? Do we have to stop here?
items.stemZh: 這個紅燈代表什麼？我們得在這裡停下來嗎？

items.passageEn: Every year our town holds a food festival, and the tickets always sell out fast. This year my friend Ken and I set out at six in the morning to wait in line. Ken usually sleeps in on weekends, so he was very tired. Many other people showed up early too. Inside, Ken tried to show off by carrying three plates at once. One plate fell, and he had to clean up the mess. We ended up laughing about it all day.
items.passageZh: 我們鎮上每年都會舉辦美食節，票總是很快就賣完。今年我和朋友 Ken 早上六點就出發去排隊。Ken 週末通常會睡懶覺，所以他很累。很多人也很早就到了。進場後，Ken 想炫耀一次端三個盤子。結果有一個盤子掉了，他只好收拾殘局。我們最後為這件事笑了一整天。

questions.questionZh: 他們為什麼早上六點就出發？
options: 想早一點去排隊買門票

questions.questionZh: Ken 想炫耀時發生了什麼事？

items.promptZh: 明天不用上學，所以我打算睡懶覺。
referenceEn: I don't have school tomorrow, so I'm going to sleep in.
There is no school tomorrow, so I plan to sleep in.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 sleep in 等；不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 sleep late、get up late 等）也算對
「打算」可寫，例如 am going to、plan to、will 等
「明天不用上學」可寫，例如 I don't have school tomorrow、There is no school tomorrow 等

items.promptZh: 她喜歡在朋友面前炫耀她的新手機。
referenceEn: She likes to show off her new phone in front of her friends.
She likes showing off her new phone to her friends.
She likes to show her new phone off to her friends.
rubricZh: 建議用片語，例如 show off her new phone 等，受詞可放中間或後面
不用片語但意思正確（例如 brag about her new phone 等）也算對
like 後面可接不定詞或動名詞（例如 likes to show、likes showing 等）
「在朋友面前」可寫，例如 in front of her friends、to her friends 等
